+def quantize_torso(lm: Any, bits: int, group_size: int) -> list[str]:
+    """Quantize merged torso projections in place; return the affected module paths."""
+    import mlx.nn as nn
+
+    selected = []
+
+    def predicate(path: str, module: Any) -> bool:
+        keep = isinstance(module, nn.Linear) and path.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] in QUANT_PROJECTIONS
+        if keep:
+            selected.append(path)
+        return keep
+
+    quantize_model(lm, {}, group_size=group_size, bits=bits, mode="affine",
+                   quant_predicate=predicate)
+    if not selected:
+        raise ValueError("No compatible torso projections were quantized")
+    mx.eval(lm.parameters())
+    return selected
